text.en: ChatGPT is row 58 of the BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual table in the LLM area.
text.zh: ChatGPT 是 BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）年度表第 58 行，所属领域为“大语言模型”。

text.en: The annual table associates ChatGPT with “ChatGPT: Optimizing Language Models for Dialogue”.
text.zh: 年度表把 ChatGPT 与论文《ChatGPT: Optimizing Language Models for Dialogue》关联。

text.en: The Main Contributors field is blank.
ChatGPT uses dialogue supervision and reinforcement learning from human feedback.
text.zh: ChatGPT 采用对话监督与基于人类反馈的强化学习。

text.en: Experts generally treat ChatGPT as the product event that made large language models a mainstream computing interface. Its legacy includes both the acceleration of conversational AI deployment and a much broader debate over hallucination, labor, education, copyright and governance.
text.zh: 专家通常把 ChatGPT 视为让大语言模型成为主流计算界面的产品事件。它的遗产既包括对话式 AI 部署加速，也包括围绕幻觉、劳动、教育、版权和治理展开的更广泛讨论。
